references.text: Othniel was also buried, illustrating the pattern of the deaths and burials of the judges in Israel.
Tola, another minor judge, died and was buried, using a similar concluding formula as for Abdon.
Jair died and was buried, following the same pattern for the minor judges as Abdon.
Ibzan from Bethlehem died and was buried, part of the same series of minor judges.
Elon died and was buried, using the same concluding formula as for Abdon.
Joshua was buried in the hill country of Ephraim, the same geographical region as Abdon from Pirathon in Ephraim.
The hill country of Ephraim is mentioned, including the area where the Amalekites had lived, the same 'mountain of the Amalekites' referred to in Abdon's burial place.
The Amalekites are mentioned as enemies of Israel, relevant for understanding the 'mountain of the Amalekites' where Abdon was buried.
Ephraim and the Amalekites are mentioned together, providing background for the place name 'the mountain of the Amalekites in the land of Ephraim'.
